service: B2B Regulatory, KYB, FinTech & SecOps MCP Server (30 Tools)
description: Official Master Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & Tool Router for all 30 B2B Regulatory, KYB, Sanctions AML, SEC EDGAR, SAM.gov, EU TED, UK FCA, Brazil BCB/PIX/Tax, Healthcare & SecOps engines (@b2b-quant-apis) with Freemium Catalog Discovery and x402 Solana USDC integration.

inputSchema.title: B2B Regulatory, KYB, FinTech & SecOps Master MCP Server (30 Tools) Input
inputSchema.description: Configure the Master MCP Server operationMode ('list_catalog', 'invoke_tool', or 'export_mcp_config'), target B2B tool name, JSON tool arguments, optional category filter, and optional Apify API token.

operationMode.title: MCP Operation Mode
operationMode.description: Select 'list_catalog' for free instant JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/list discovery of all 30 B2B tools, 'invoke_tool' to dispatch/validate a specific B2B tool call, or 'export_mcp_config' to generate ready-to-paste Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and x402 configs.

toolName.title: Target B2B Tool / Actor Slug
toolName.description: Slug or MCP tool name of any of the 30 underlying @b2b-quant-apis engines (e.g., 'us-sec-edgar-filings-insider-radar', 'global-sanctions-pep-interpol-watchlist-screener', 'brazil-b2b-cnpj-qsa-lead-enricher').

toolArguments.title: Tool Call JSON Arguments
toolArguments.description: Structured JSON arguments passed to the target B2B tool when operationMode is 'invoke_tool'.

categoryFilter.title: Catalog Category Filter
categoryFilter.description: Filter the 30 B2B tools by domain category in 'list_catalog' mode ('ALL', 'FINANCE_KYB', 'GOVCON_PROCUREMENT', 'SECOPS_CYBER', 'HEALTHCARE_BIOTECH', 'BRAZIL_B2B_TAX', or 'ESG_LOGISTICS_GEO').

apifyApiToken.title: Apify API Token (Optional for Live Dispatch)
apifyApiToken.description: Optional Apify API Token to execute a live synchronous REST call against the target @b2b-quant-apis Actor during 'invoke_tool'. If omitted, returns a deterministic validated MCP execution envelope.

maxTools.title: Maximum Tools Returned
maxTools.description: Maximum number of B2B tool definitions to return in 'list_catalog' mode (1 to 30).

operationMode.title: MCP Operation Mode
operationMode.description: Executed router mode: list_catalog, invoke_tool, or export_mcp_config.

actorSlug.title: Apify Actor Slug
actorSlug.description: Full @b2b-quant-apis Actor slug on Apify Store.

domainCategory.title: B2B Domain Category
domainCategory.description: Classified vertical category (FINANCE_KYB, GOVCON_PROCUREMENT, SECOPS_CYBER, etc.).

pricePerEventUsd.title: PPE Price (USD)
pricePerEventUsd.description: Pay-Per-Event price in USD on Apify Store and x402 Solana USDC gateway.

mcpStreamableHttpUrl.title: Streamable HTTP MCP Endpoint
mcpStreamableHttpUrl.description: Direct Hosted Apify MCP Server URL for this tool.

x402SolanaEndpoint.title: x402 Solana USDC Endpoint
x402SolanaEndpoint.description: Stateless x402 endpoint settling in USDC on Solana Mainnet.

readinessScore.title: M2M & Agent Readiness Score (0-100)
readinessScore.description: Quantitative schema, MCP, and x402 readiness score (0-100).

mcpJsonRpcEnvelope.title: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Envelope
mcpJsonRpcEnvelope.description: Complete JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/list, tools/call, or configuration payload.

markdownMcpBrief.title: Markdown MCP & x402 Integration Brief
markdownMcpBrief.description: Executive Markdown documentation and 1-Click setup snippet for AI Agents.
